summary: Iteration 2 testing of the 3 new features (real file uploads via Emergent object storage, Leaflet maps, 2.5s chat polling) + full regression. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_uploads_maps_chat.py (22 tests) covering POST /api/upload (auth required, png ok, bad extension 400, >8MB 400), GET /api/files/{path} (401 no token, 401 bad token, 200 via ?auth=, 200 via Bearer, 404 unknown path), nakes document file_url persistence + admin visibility + admin doc/nakes verify, provider search exposing latitude/longitude, SOAP medical record with photo attachment + patient read + cross-patient 403, and chat send/poll ordering + outsider 403. Result 22/22 pass. Regression: backend_test.py 57/57 pass and test_authz_probe.py 7/7 pass (all iteration-1 IDOR gaps now closed, brute-force lockout works). Frontend: found and unblocked a CRITICAL crash — react-leaflet 4.2.1 is not compatible with React 19 and threw 'Map container is already initialized.', white-screening the ENTIRE patient dashboard (Beranda hosts the map) and the nakes 'Profil & Lokasi' tab. Upgraded react-leaflet to 5.0.0 (yarn) which fixed it; after that the full UI journey passed: patient map renders with blue 'Lokasi Anda' marker, map click updates search-lat/search-lng, search returns 6 providers with 6 green nakes markers; nakes profile map click updates nakes-lat/nakes-lng and coordinates persist after save+reload; document upload (doc-file) shows preview, error toast when adding without a file, document row with loaded thumbnail + 'Menunggu' status; invalid .txt upload rejected with backend 400 + error toast; SOAP wound photo uploaded and thumbnail rendered, record submitted; patient 'Rekam Medis' shows 'Dokumentasi Foto' with the authenticated image loaded (naturalWidth>0, ?auth= in src); chat message appears in the open dialog and an incoming message posted out-of-band appeared within 4s (2.5s polling); patient QRIS pay + review, admin verification detail shows the document thumbnail and approve works, admin payment verification works; mobile 390px map renders with tiles.

minor.issue: Authorization only validates that the JWT is well-formed — any authenticated user (any role) can fetch ANY file path, including another patient's wound photos and other nakes' STR/SIP scans. Security relies solely on the random uuid filename. Add an ownership/relationship check (file owner, the order's patient/nakes, or admin).

put_object/get_object use the blocking `requests` library inside async endpoints (no thread offloading) — an 8MB upload/download blocks the FastAPI event loop for the whole request. Use httpx.AsyncClient or starlette run_in_threadpool.
LOGIN_ATTEMPTS is a process-local dict: lockout state is lost on restart and is not shared across replicas. Also no unlock on password reset. Acceptable for preview, not for production.
Whole file is read into memory before the size check (`await file.read()` then len>8MB), so a malicious 500MB upload is buffered fully before rejection. Check Content-Length / stream in chunks.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 910 lines — split into routers (auth, nakes, orders, payments, files, admin).
serve_file() authenticates but does not authorize: it should verify the caller is the file owner, a party to the order that references the file, or an admin.
init_storage/put_object/get_object are synchronous `requests` calls inside async handlers; also storage_key is a module global with no lock (concurrent 404-retries can re-init twice).

AuthImage puts the raw JWT in the image URL query string (?auth=), which leaks the token into browser history, proxy/access logs and Referer headers. Prefer a short-lived signed file token or an httpOnly-cookie-authenticated file route.
FileUpload does no client-side size/type pre-check, so users must wait for an 8MB round-trip before being told the format is unsupported.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the map crash: package.json pinned react-leaflet 4.2.1 while React/react-dom are 19.0.0. react-leaflet 4.x re-runs MapContainer's layout effect on React 19's remount/reappear pass without removing the previous Leaflet instance, so Leaflet throws 'Map container is already initialized.'; the uncaught error unmounted the whole React tree, blanking the patient dashboard (map is on the default Beranda tab) and the nakes Profil tab. Reproduction: log in as siti@pasien.id -> /pasien renders blank with pageerror 'Map container is already initialized.'. Mitigation applied: `yarn add react-leaflet@^5.0.0` (pulls @react-leaflet/core 3.0.0, the React 19-compatible release) + frontend restart; map, tiles, markers, click-to-pick and popups then render with zero page errors.
